key.name: enabled-effects
key.description: List of animated pattern IDs active on the desktop wallpaper.

key.name: pattern-tuning
key.description: For each pattern id, any of "brightness", "speed" and "density" (the Amount setting), as multipliers of the pattern's design. Missing entries are 1.

key.name: span-monitors
key.description: Draw the patterns, and a gradient base, as one picture across every monitor instead of one per monitor.

key.name: saved-scenes
key.description: Scenes saved from the preferences: each a "name" and the values of the keys a scene covers.

key.name: background-mode
key.description: Base layer underneath patterns: 'desktop' (the system wallpaper), 'accent' (a gradient in GNOME's accent colour), 'color' (a palette gradient), 'image' (a custom picture), or 'daytime' (a picture for each time of day).

key.name: color-palette
key.description: Color scheme used when background-mode is 'color'.

key.name: custom-image
key.description: Path to custom wallpaper image used when background-mode is 'image'.

key.name: daytime-images
key.summary: Pictures for each time of day
key.description: Paths of the pictures used when background-mode is 'daytime', by period: 'dawn', 'day', 'dusk' and 'night'. A period without one uses the nearest that has one.

key.name: target-fps
key.description: How often the patterns are redrawn, in step with each display's own refresh: 0 is every frame it shows, a negative number every Nth frame (-2 every other one), and a positive number the nearest whole share of the display's rate to that many frames a second.

key.name: speed
key.description: Pace multiplier for all animations (0.25 to 3.0).

key.name: opacity
key.description: Global opacity of the animated patterns (0.1 to 1.0).

key.name: pause-when-covered
key.summary: Pause while windows cover the desktop
key.description: Stops drawing on a monitor while a fullscreen window, or maximized and tiled windows between them, hide its desktop.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Stops the animation while the device is running on battery.

key.name: parallax
key.description: Slide the wallpaper and pattern layers with workspace switches.

key.name: parallax-amount
key.description: Total travel across workspaces as a share of the monitor's width.

key.name: parallax-depth
key.description: How far the patterns pan, as a multiple of each one's own depth; 0 holds them still.

key.name: parallax-blur-my-shell
key.summary: Move Blur My Shell's wallpaper with the parallax
key.description: Blur My Shell's static blur paints a wallpaper of its own; this moves it with the desktop's, so the blur matches what is behind it.

key.name: pointer-tilt
key.description: The wallpaper and patterns lean away from the pointer on the desktop.

key.name: pointer-tilt-amount
key.description: How far the wallpaper moves either side of centre, as a share of the monitor.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether workspace names are shown on a switch and can be edited in place. Off, none of the keys below has any effect.

key.name: rename-shortcut
key.description: Opens the title of the workspace in view for editing. Empty is no shortcut.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether a button in the top bar opens the title for editing.

key.name: indicator-position
key.description: Left, just right of the workspace indicator; centre, right of the clock; or right, left of the system menu.

key.name: show-on-hover
key.description: Whether resting the pointer on the workspace indicator at the left of the top bar shows the current workspace's title.

key.name: title-position
key.description: At the top of the screen, or in its middle.

key.name: title-size
key.description: The size of the workspace name shown on a switch.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether a workspace switch is a camera move through a scene. Off, the shell slides as usual.

key.name: scene
key.description: The scene a switch passes through, or "random" for a different one each time.

key.name: duration
key.description: Milliseconds a switch to the next workspace takes; a longer jump takes up to half as long again.

key.name: step-rate
key.description: How often the scene is redrawn, as anime holds each drawing for two or three frames. 0 draws it on every frame. The workspaces always move smoothly.

key.name: focus-lines
key.description: Radial speed lines while the camera is at speed.

key.name: impact-frame
key.description: One inverted drawing of the scene as the new workspace arrives.
